scope: Full-length gallery preview of Editorial, rendered at half scale from the current template code. Automated checks plus a review of frames sampled every 4 s; not a frame-by-frame or subjective listening acceptance.

renders.renderCommand: npx remotion render examples/cases.tsx VVV-Editorial OUT.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=24 --audio-bitrate=128k
renders.encodeCommand: ffmpeg -i OUT.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 28 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -c:a copy PUBLIC.mp4

checks.message: Short side is 540px; review delivery quality at 1080px or more.
Strongest visual changes sit 47 ms from the nearest beat on average.

beatMaps: The fixture track's beat map (public/music/mixkit-when-in-love.beats.json); trimBeforeSec is 0.
changes: Editorial: new template, recreated from a reference film; first published preview.
visualReview: Frames every 4 s of the public file reviewed as a tiled sheet: complete, no black or frozen frames, every page and transition present.
